title: 2026 NFL Transactions — Reserve List, November
retrieval_method: Read with the sandbox web fetcher; the first 20 rows of the November block transcribed verbatim, in published order.
why_it_matters: A player absent from the weekly injury report is not necessarily available. The reserve list is the second official place a player can be: on IR, he is off the report and off the field. Taken alone, the injury report cannot distinguish 'healthy' from 'on IR'.

cross_checks.claim: A player on injured reserve is absent from the injury report
cross_checks.evidence: TreVeyon Henderson was listed on the week-10 report as 'Out' (Illness) and appears on the reserve list dated 11/14 as Reserve/Injured.

cross_checks.claim: Malik Willis is on injured reserve, so his absence from a weekly report is not evidence of health
